body.placement: A functional benefic is a favorable planet in a chart. Placement of a functional benefic in quadrants (sustenance) and trines (prosperity) brings good results. Placement of a functional malefic in these houses is not good, unless it is very strong. A functional malefic placed in the 3rd house and dusthanas (6th, 8th and 12th houses) brings good results, by spoiling the significations of the bad houses.

body.table_is_the_authority: Table 30 is what section 13.2 gives for use, so it is what we serve. The five stated rules are applied separately and agree on 72 of the table's 81 cells; the nine that differ are listed under `divergences`, and eight of them are planets owning two rasis — exactly what "judiciously combine" warns about.
